Already have a set from your coach? Paste it here and Laneset reads it into the same paced session it builds for you: every interval gets a target time from your own pace and the pool you swim in.

A section word such as Warm up, Main set or Cool down starts a group, then one line per set. Laneset reads a repetitions-and-distance pair like 8 x 100 free on 1:45, a single distance like 300, a stroke word such as free, back, breast, fly or IM, a send-off such as on 1:45 or @1:10, and an explicit rest like rest 20. The section words and the stroke words are the ones a pool writes in English; everything else is a number.
The set you paste appears here, interval by interval, before anything is saved.
